Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.draw

Class DrawRect

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.history.draw.DrawRect
@Component public class DrawRect extends Object
Provides rectangle drawing utilities for visualizing matches and regions on OpenCV Mat images.

This class is a core component of the Brobot visualization system, offering various methods to draw rectangles around or directly on matches, regions, and other rectangular areas. It handles boundary checking to ensure rectangles stay within image bounds and provides both single and batch drawing operations.

Key features:

  • Draw rectangles around matches with 1-pixel padding
  • Draw rectangles directly on match boundaries
  • Batch operations for multiple regions
  • Automatic boundary clipping to prevent out-of-bounds drawing
  • Support for custom colors via OpenCV Scalar

Drawing modes:

  • Around - Adds 1-pixel padding around the target area
  • On - Draws exactly on the target boundaries

Common use cases:

  • Highlighting found matches in automation results
  • Visualizing search regions during debugging
  • Creating annotated screenshots for documentation
  • Drawing bounding boxes for object detection results

Thread safety: This class is stateless and thread-safe. Multiple threads can use the same instance concurrently.

  • Method Details

    • drawRectAroundMatch

      public void drawRectAroundMatch(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, Match match, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws a rectangle around a match with 1-pixel padding on all sides.

      This method adds visual emphasis by drawing the rectangle slightly outside the match boundaries, making it easier to see the match edges. The rectangle is automatically clipped to stay within the image bounds.

      Boundary handling:

      • X coordinates are clamped to [0, image width]
      • Y coordinates are clamped to [0, image height]
      • 1-pixel padding is added where possible
      Parameters:
      scene - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Must not be null.
      match - The match whose boundaries define the rectangle. Must not be null.
      color - The color of the rectangle as an OpenCV Scalar (e.g., new Scalar(0,255,0) for green).

    • drawRectOnMatch

      public void drawRectOnMatch(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat scene, Match match, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws a rectangle directly on the match boundaries without padding.

      This method draws the rectangle exactly on the match edges, useful when precise boundary visualization is needed. The rectangle is automatically clipped to stay within the image bounds.

      Parameters:
      scene - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Must not be null.
      match - The match whose boundaries define the rectangle. Must not be null.
      color - The color of the rectangle as an OpenCV Scalar.

    • drawRect

      public void drawRect(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mat, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Rect rect, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws a rectangle directly on the specified OpenCV Rect boundaries.

      This is a lower-level method that works directly with OpenCV Rect objects. The rectangle is drawn exactly on the rect boundaries with automatic boundary clipping.

      Parameters:
      mat - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Must not be null.
      rect - The OpenCV Rect defining the rectangle boundaries. Must not be null.
      color - The color of the rectangle as an OpenCV Scalar.

    • drawRectAroundMatch

      public void drawRectAroundMatch(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mat, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Rect rect, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws a rectangle around an OpenCV Rect with 1-pixel padding.

      Similar to drawRectAroundMatch(Mat, Match, Scalar) but works directly with OpenCV Rect objects. Adds 1-pixel padding on all sides where possible within image bounds.

      Parameters:
      mat - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Must not be null.
      rect - The OpenCV Rect around which to draw. Must not be null.
      color - The color of the rectangle as an OpenCV Scalar.

    • drawRectAroundMatch

      public void drawRectAroundMatch(Visualization illScn, List<Region> searchRegions, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws rectangles around multiple regions on both scene and class illustrations.

      This batch operation method draws rectangles on two different visualization layers provided by the Illustrations object. This is useful for showing the same regions on different visual representations simultaneously.

      Parameters:
      illScn - The Illustrations object containing both scene and class visualizations.
      searchRegions - List of regions to draw rectangles around. Empty lists are handled safely.
      color - The color of the rectangles as an OpenCV Scalar.

    • drawRectAroundRegions

      public void drawRectAroundRegions(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mat, List<Region> searchRegions, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws rectangles around multiple regions in a single batch operation.

      This method efficiently draws rectangles around all provided regions. Each region is converted to a Match object for drawing. Null Mat objects are handled safely by returning early.

      Parameters:
      mat - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Can be null (method returns early).
      searchRegions - List of regions to draw rectangles around. Each region is converted to a match.
      color - The color of the rectangles as an OpenCV Scalar.

    • drawRectAroundRegion

      public void drawRectAroundRegion(org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Mat mat, Region region, org.bytedeco.opencv.opencv_core.Scalar color)
      Draws a rectangle around a single region with 1-pixel padding.

      Convenience method for drawing a rectangle around a single Region object. The region is converted to a Match for drawing. Null Mat objects are handled safely.

      Parameters:
      mat - The OpenCV Mat image on which to draw. Can be null (method returns early).
      region - The region around which to draw the rectangle. Must not be null.
      color - The color of the rectangle as an OpenCV Scalar.
